question: Which offices may address an in-app or push notification to one member or to a group of members, in whose name does it appear to the recipient, may a member opt out of push and in-app notices by class, and which office owns the registry of member devices, including what happens to a device row when the device passes to another account or the member leaves the organization?
decision: Case notices may be sent only by authorized assigned handlers to participants within their grant; bulk/group notices require an approved organizational communications mandate. Store authenticated sender and purpose. Members can opt out of nonessential push/marketing; required security or legal-deadline alerts must still be delivered by a safe supported channel, but never expose sensitive case content on lock-screen push. Single device registry with account/tenant binding, secure token rotation and immediate deactivation on logout, account switch or departure.
originalProposedDecision: Stewards may notify members of cases they are assigned to; officers and admins may notify groups. Every notice shows the sending office and is stored with its sender. Members may opt out of every class except security and case-deadline notices. One device table; a device row is deactivated on sign-out, account change or leaving the org.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
